evidence.quote: when you read why the creative won or lost, you have to think about the customer journey like how we saw here. First, did we get their attention? If nobody stops, maybe the hook isn't strong enough. Maybe the visual itself just isn't that interesting. Then we ask, did they click to the site? If people are watching and nobody's clicking, well, maybe the creative is entertaining but the product and the value isn't compelling or even being communicated. Maybe they don't understand why they need this product.
